name: curved railways
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 线路平面几何包含曲线的铁路区段。

complete_examples.text: In this section, the established TTTS model is employed to investigate the vibrations of tunnel-soil system induced by moving trains on curved railways.
Finally, the TTTS model is employed to explore the tunnel-soil system dynamic responses under straight and curved railways with varying soil elastic conditions.
